results.content: POLL WOES: President Donald Trump has fallen out of favor with a majority of Tennessee voters. Beacon has polled Tennesseans since 2023, and this is the first time those numbers have skewed that way. In the November election, though, Tennessee remains decidedly supportive of Republicans.
